moat_against: No returns on capital, ever: roic_proxy negative in every recent year (-43.9% FY2023, -15.4% FY2024, -29.1% FY2025 in fundamentals.json), gross margin null in every year (no revenue has ever been filed), owner's earnings positive 0/5 of the last 5 years

Unapproved single-product concentration: essentially all value is VAX-31, still facing OPUS-2 / OPUS-3 readouts (H1 2027), a manufacturing consistency study and a BLA planned only for H1 2028 — binary regulatory and manufacturing risk remains
Entrenched incumbents: Pfizer (Prevnar 20) and Merck (Capvaxive) own the recommendation, payer and commercial infrastructure Vaxcyte has yet to build

Heavy, rising dilution: share count CAGR 28.0%/yr (dcf_numbers.json) and SBC rising every year — $48,760,000 (FY2023) to $84,822,000 (FY2024) to $138,845,000 (FY2025) to $150,508,000 TTM (financials_history.csv / ttm.json) — with another ~$500M equity + pre-funded warrant raise priced in October 2026
moat_for: Broadest-spectrum PCV in the clinic: 31-valent VAX-31 vs Pfizer Prevnar 20 (20-valent) and Merck Capvaxive (21-valent); OPUS-1 Phase 3 met all prespecified primary immunogenicity and safety endpoints on Oct 5, 2026 (cited search results)

Proprietary cell-free protein synthesis platform (licensed from Sutro Biopharma) designed to add serotypes without the immune-interference that limits conventional conjugation — the basis for VAX-24, VAX-31 and earlier-stage VAX-A1 / VAX-GI

Fortress liquidity for a pre-revenue company: cash, cash equivalents and investments of $2,507.7M at June 30, 2026 (Q2 2026 reporting, cited search result), plus an October 2026 financing of ~$500M equity and ~$500M of 1.50% convertible notes announced after OPUS-1
moat_justification: No demonstrated economics at all: zero revenue in every filed year, gross margin null throughout fundamentals.json, and roic_proxy negative in every recent year (-43.9% FY2023, -15.4% FY2024, -29.1% FY2025 in fundamentals.json), with conservative owner's earnings negative 0/5 of the last 5 years. The asset is real but unproven commercially — VAX-31 is the broadest-spectrum pneumococcal conjugate vaccine in the clinic (31-valent vs Pfizer's Prevnar 20 and Merck's Capvaxive) on a proprietary cell-free protein synthesis platform, and OPUS-1 met all primary endpoints on Oct 5, 2026 — but it is unapproved (BLA planned H1 2028), has no commercial infrastructure, and faces two entrenched incumbents. A 3 gives CAP 5.9 years.
name: Vaxcyte, Inc.
one_liner: Pre-revenue vaccine developer with a genuinely broader PCV candidate, moat 3/10 — but owner's earnings are negative on every basis (TTM base -$7.36/share; FY2025 -$5.94/share; 3-yr median -$4.59/share) and TTM operating cash flow itself is -$881,233,000 before SBC — Tier F on this screen; it does not clear 15% at any price on current numbers and no hurdle-clearing price is computed on a negative base. The $63.62 price pays for OPUS-1 success and a 2028 BLA, not for cash generation that has never occurred.
